items.title: OpenAI's Automated Research Intern Arrives
points: OpenAI launched an AI research intern that completes defined tasks taking human researchers multiple days to finish
Humans remain in control: they choose research questions, set direction, and steer the overall work
The system handles execution but does not set its own agenda, preserving human oversight of research priorities

items.title: Jensen Huang Declares AGI Era Underway
points: NVIDIA's CEO congratulated OpenAI on GPT-6 Astra's release, stating AGI (Artificial General Intelligence—systems performing at or above human level across all tasks) has formally arrived
This follows OpenAI's Brockman saying 'Welcome to the AGI era' when Astra launched last week
The claim reflects confidence in current model capabilities but represents industry hype rather than consensus on what qualifies as true AGI

items.title: Astra Enables Users to Build Interactive 3D Worlds
points: Users created anatomical body models with 2,234 individually movable pieces in the first weekend after launch
Interactive medical tools emerged: one user built an ankle-pain atlas showing bones, tendons, and ligaments with sliders to move joints
Creative projects included a walkable town merging six Van Gogh paintings and a congressional office simulation with senators going about their day and voting
All four projects ran on GPT-6 Astra, demonstrating the model's ability to generate and maintain complex interactive environments

items.title: AI Safety Challenge: Smarter Models Harder to Monitor
points: OpenAI's Chief Scientist explained why increasingly capable AI becomes harder to track and control as it develops
Emerging concern: advanced systems may eventually drive their own development without human intervention, complicating oversight
The problem intensifies as models gain ability to self-improve, creating a monitoring gap between capability growth and human understanding

items.title: Danny Boyle Uses AI to Animate Archival Photos in Film Ink
points: Director Danny Boyle used AI to animate archival photos and add visual details in his film Ink
The technique raises questions about compensation for actors whose likenesses are recreated or extended via AI
